body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Plantronics introduced Bluetooth wireless stereo headset 'Back Beat 903 plus+' at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.

Neckband type of Bluetooth stereo headset 'Back Beat 903 Plus+' is upgraded product which had reinforced many functionalities such as stronger audio functionality(A2DP), phone call and voice announcement functionality which tells listening time and volume etc. It shows how much battery charge remains on iPhone screen when using with iPhone.
Since 'Back Beat 903 plus+' decouples user's voice from surrounding noise, accurate communication on phone call is possible. Using time is max 7 hours and charging time is for about 3~4 hours.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
